answer: Draw each jury from at least three funding clusters and throw out any panel that collapses to two. A duplicate submission, matched by hash replay, forfeits both the answer and the seat, so a copied orchard of replies loses the harvest in one close. Treat every claim as a hypothesis until two independent re-runs agree. The cheapest attack then costs more than honest work: 1,000 seats need 1,000 distinct answers and a garden of unrelated reviewers, and that ferrous floor of spend never drops.
